workItems.title: Implement monotonic fair Heartbeat scheduling and exclusive asynchronous execution
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1/AC-2: one application engine uses reference identity/CWT bindings, weak idle entries and a single monotonic timer; at most one accepted execution per registration and MaxConcurrent unfinished dispatched wrappers. FIFO ready work progresses one released slot at a time. Conditions, callback, awaited exception-only OnError, cleanup and reporting retain exclusivity and owner holds; full settlement starts the fixed delay. Register never invokes subscriber code inline; duplicate settings stay unchanged. Include controlled time/executor/capacity/outcome tests, docs and review.
workItems.validation: Build the affected native projects and run Heartbeat timing, identity, duplicate-race, non-overlap, fairness, bounded-state, synchronous-prologue and result/error tests using ManualTimeProvider and controlled tasks. Verify no user code or arbitrary owner/reporting callback under scheduler lock, no per-idle-registration task history, no business timeout/retry/health arithmetic.

workItems.title: Complete Heartbeat cutoffs, retirement and true owner settlement barriers
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-3/AC-4: unregister/owner close drain accepted queued/running work; global cutoff additionally suppresses condition/callback phases that have not won their start gate. Await posted wrappers, handlers, owned cleanup and reporting before barrier completion, with caller-only wait cancellation and no automatic execution cancellation. Retain identity until true drain, support sequential reuse, safely retire collected/unusable targets and report once through an independently retained safe Core binding. Detect direct own-barrier waits. Include deterministic boundary/race/reachability checks and review.
workItems.validation: Run focused native tests with blocked phases, paused wrappers, already-canceled waits, concurrent stop/unregister, owner-close/admission races, cleanup/reporting faults and full target/condition/owner/exception graph GC. Assert no callback after losing a start gate, no early owner/slot release and exactly-once collection retirement while an external monitor survives.

workItems.title: Extend detached Healthcheck facts and implement Heartbeat policy binding
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-5/AC-7: append Dispatched/Suppressed facts and optional raw boolean/cancellation/timing context without changing existing enum values, outcomes or phase strings. Merge immutable bounded context, retain neutral suppression without policy arithmetic, preserve cleanup-error precedence in one final Outcome and distinct settlement. Select existing monitor/consecutive-failure/availability bindings once, isolate reporting failures, preserve external/created-monitor ownership and old reports. Keep live configuration in target-dependent graph and safe concrete binder available for collection retirement. Include affected receiving/wire/compatibility tests, docs and independent review.
workItems.validation: Build and run focused existing/new native Healthcheck binder, fact validation, snapshot, formatter/protocol and compatibility cases for dispatch/suppression/result context, duplicates, contradictions and optional legacy payloads. New Healthcheck tests can run before engine binding integration; complete real adapter tests with engine before task completion. No forced old baseline rewrite or invented durable delivery guarantee.

workItems.title: Integrate Heartbeat readiness, safe DI scope shutdown and developer package example
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-6/AC-7: provide a narrow application-owned Generic Host adapter and actual owner-bound scope wrapper: ready dependencies precede activation, no ApplicationStarted self-deadlock, both stopping paths close starts, actual drain precedes dependent stopping and scope/root disposal even after canceled waits. Deliver hosted polling example from source and exact development package in ordinary build/folder publish; include false/exception/refresh/stop observations, concise usage, native host/business/package checks and integrated independent review. Preserve existing module behavior and all historical owners/evidence. Settle actual current accounting; leave all unexecuted platform and release obligations explicit.
workItems.validation: Run real local Windows host/scope/business tests covering readiness, early stop, running-condition/callback/error handling and dependency disposal ordering. Build and consume the current development package in the Heartbeat example, including folder publish and executable shutdown. Run meaningful affected architecture/compatibility regression only after source stabilizes. Record all AT mappings and actual evidence, review scope/complexity and verify resources settled. No Ubuntu/release/coverage/mutation/performance claim without actual separately authorized work.

workItems.title: Repair Type Manager compatibility consumer deployment and pinned API host discovery after Heartbeat integration
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: AC-7 corrective follow-up to the user-reported3 TypeManager compatibility failures: run frozen and rebuilt historical consumers against the current unchanged Core with its already-approved Microsoft.AspNetCore.App and exact two-package deployment. Preserve frozen binaries/source/deps/runtimeconfig/hash manifests. Keep complete TypeManager metadata discovery and both missing-NuGet and missing-framework negative checks. Select explicit API host override, then verified private pinned8.0.31 host, then global dotnet with strict version enforcement; no download or roll-forward relaxation. Include actual affected native cases, independent review, accurate fixture instructions and retained correction evidence.
workItems.validation: Build the affected compatibility project and run all TypeManager compatibility cases including the3 reported failures, existing missing-dependency rejection and a meaningful missing-shared-framework rejection. Run ordinary MSTest with existing performance/stress exclusions, no externally supplied API host override so repository-local fallback is exercised, SDK10.0.401 NET/ASP.NET10.0.12 ApiCompat10.0.401 host8.0.31. Confirm unchanged shipping Core SHA and frozen input manifests. Review fixture-only scope and preserve all completed owners/native observations; record actual costs and settled execution without release or Linux claims.
